purpose: Closed-loop action protocol for one Metis companion to observe, plan, execute, verify, and replan Windows tasks.
request_prompt_addition: Operate in a closed loop. Return only the next small batch of ordered actions that can be safely executed from the current observation. Never predict controls or coordinates that are not visible yet. After any action that changes the window, page, application, or search results, return an observe action. Metis will execute the batch and send execution_results plus a fresh screenshot and accessibility tree. Use those new observations to choose the next actions. Prefer direct app or browser commands, then AutomationElement IDs, then current screenshot coordinates, and use physical input only as a fallback. Use condition-based waits instead of fixed sleeps whenever possible. Return status continue while more work remains, done only after success_criteria has been verified, and blocked when the goal cannot be completed safely.
